system:
You are a NEUTRAL AI case assessor supporting an arbitrator in a commercial dispute between Aster Retail (the client, which terminated the contract) and Delphin Systems (the vendor).

Question: How likely is it that Aster Retail's termination of Delphin Systems for material breach was legally justified? P=0 clearly wrongful termination; P=50 genuinely balanced; P=100 clearly justified.

Calibration: P=50 means the evidence so far is genuinely balanced. It is correct and expected to stay near 50 when items cut both ways; move only as far as the evidence actually warrants, and state your confidence honestly.

You will receive the items one at a time. After each item, give your assessment based only on the items received so far. You will not be able to revise earlier assessments.

After each item reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"p": <0-100>, "conf": "<LOW|MED|HIGH>", "reason": "<15 words or fewer>"}
When told all items have been provided, reply with ONE JSON object:
{"p": <0-100>, "conf": "<LOW|MED|HIGH>", "reason": "<one line>"}

exchanges.user:
=== EVIDENCE BUNDLE (submitted by the parties; weigh each item critically, and note that any cover-notes are the parties' own characterisations, not findings) ===
[Instructing note]: Instructing note: Please assess the enclosed evidence bundle in the Aster/Delphin dispute and give a running, calibrated view on whether Aster's termination for material breach was justified. The record is mixed; weigh each item on its merits.

=== ITEM 1 ===
Email thread: Delphin's PM writes 'apologies the dates slipped, largely due to the extra reporting you asked for'. Aster's PM replies 'understood, let's keep pushing'.

Your assessment after item 1:
exchanges.text: {"p": 44, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Delay attributed partly to Aster's extra requests; Aster acquiesced, suggesting waiver or shared cause."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 2 ===
An internal Aster memo dated two weeks before termination notes 'budget pressure this quarter' and 'we may need to exit the Delphin contract if it doesn't turn around'.

Your assessment after item 2:
exchanges.text: {"p": 40, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Budget motive suggests pretext risk, though 'if it doesn't turn around' implies genuine performance concern."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 3 ===
Delphin's final status report (pre-termination) claims 90% completion and attaches a remediation plan; two of the plan's dates repeat dates that had already been missed. Aster terminated nine days later.

Your assessment after item 3:
exchanges.text: {"p": 44, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Remediation plan recycling missed dates undermines Delphin's credibility; but 90% complete and quick termination cut both ways."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 4 ===
The contract sets four milestones and states 'time is of the essence', but also provides a 15-business-day cure period for any alleged breach and a formal change-control process for scope changes.

Your assessment after item 4:
exchanges.text: {"p": 41, "conf": "LOW", "reason": "Time-of-essence helps Aster, but 15-day cure period and change-control raise questions about procedure and scope creep."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 5 ===
Milestones 2 and 3 were both delivered late (3 weeks and 2 weeks respectively). Delphin did not invoke the contractual change-control process to reset either date.

Your assessment after item 5:
exchanges.text: {"p": 49, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Documented lateness with time-of-essence; Delphin's failure to use change-control weakens its scope-creep excuse."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 6 ===
UAT recorded 14 defects, 3 marked 'critical'. One critical defect was fixed; the other two recurred after the first fix and were still open at the date of termination.

Your assessment after item 6:
exchanges.text: {"p": 55, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Two critical defects unresolved at termination strengthens material breach; cure-period compliance still unclear."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 7 ===
Aster withheld the Milestone 2 payment and issued a withholding notice that specified the non-conformities by cross-reference to the numbered items in the UAT defect log.

Your assessment after item 7:
exchanges.text: {"p": 58, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Formal, specific withholding notice shows Aster documented breaches properly; supports procedural compliance."}

exchanges.user:
=== ITEM 8 ===
Aster's termination letter cites 'repeated and material breaches'. Delphin's reply asserts the termination is wrongful, that it was ready and able to cure, and reserves its rights.

Your assessment after item 8:
exchanges.text: {"p": 57, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Standard positions; Delphin's cure claim unproven, but whether 15-day cure period ran remains unresolved."}

exchanges.user: All items have been provided. Give your FINAL assessment.
exchanges.text: {"p": 57, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Documented late milestones, open critical defects and a recycled remediation plan favour Aster, but acquiescence to delays, budget motive, and unclear compliance with the 15-day cure period keep it only modestly above balanced."}

final_text: {"p": 57, "conf": "MED", "reason": "Documented late milestones, open critical defects and a recycled remediation plan favour Aster, but acquiescence to delays, budget motive, and unclear compliance with the 15-day cure period keep it only modestly above balanced."}
